EARLY BIRDS GET 10 % DISCOUNT - OFFER ENDS JUNE 15, 2015

 

MY Leaders Summer Camp 2015 is a collaborative project of MY Project USA and the Institute of Youth Development and Excellence. It is specially designed to empower Muslim youth (13 -17) in finding their role and place within their community and society. 


All participants will first learn skills to empower themselves. They will then find a social justice issue that matters to them. They will plan an initiative to address that issue. By the end of the camp, they will be ready to launch their initiatives, inshaAllah. Mentoring options will be available after the camp for youth interested in seeking more guidance through their journey in making their dreams into successful organizations. 

TOPICS/SKILLS INCLUDE
Sense of self - Understanding Power
Self Discovery - what needs to change
Sense of others - Knowing the community
Identifying obligations - Nature of responsibility
Understanding Community Service
Islamic Ethics of Leadership – Accountability 
Planning, Organizing and Promoting a Community Service Initiative 

MAIN INSTRUCTORS 
Riyad Shamma
Zerqa Abid

DATES & TIME 
Classes: August 5 -15. 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM
No Classes on Weekend (Aug 8 & 9)
Completion Ceremony – August 15, 11:00 AM

SCHEDULE FOR THE DAY
09:45 -10:00 Arrival
10:00 -10:50 Session 1
11:00 -12:00 Session 2
12:00 - 01:30 Lunch / Salah
01:30 - 02:15 Physical activity/ art / fun stuff
02:30 - 04:00 Session 3
04:00 Departure

FEE: 
Individual 400/person
Group of 5 and more 350/person
Group of 10 and more 300/person

 

EARLY BIRDS GET 10% DISCOUNT UNTIL JUNE 15, 2015

Can’t Pay, No Problem – Can Apply for Scholarship
Scholarship Application Deadline: July 10th, 2015.
